rows.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for a woman who rents out property, especially to tenants.

example.english: The landlady came to collect the rent again.
example.jyutping: baau1 zou1 po4 jau6 lai4 ceoi1 zou1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when referring to the female landlord in her capacity as the property owner; it does not specify that the owner is a woman.

example.english: The landlady decided not to renew the lease for this shop.
example.traditional: 呢間舖嘅業主決定唔續租畀人。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 ge3 jip6 zyu2 kyut3 ding6 m4 zuk6 zou1 bei2 jan4
